Mozambique vs Guinea: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 09.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of an African qualifier for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, as the Mozambique national team hosts one of the group favorites, Guinea. This clash promises to be tense, as both teams are fighting for a historic World Cup qualification.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 09, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Mozambique national team has shown impressive progress in recent years. The 'Mambas' had an excellent start to the qualifiers, securing several victories and establishing themselves as a very resilient opponent, especially at their home arena. A victory against a direct competitor would allow Mozambique to make a strong claim for first place in the group.

The Guinea national team is one of the strongest in Africa and has a squad with players from Europe's top 5 leagues, including Stuttgart star Serhou Guirassy. The 'National Elephants' also had a successful start to the qualifiers but suffered an unexpected defeat, which has made them take every match more seriously. For Guinea, the game in Mozambique is key in the fight for leadership.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history of encounters between these teams in recent years favors Guinea. The Guineans won the last two head-to-head matches in the 2019 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers (both 1-0).

Mozambique vs Guinea Prediction

Despite Mozambique's home-field advantage, bookmakers consider Guinea the slight favorites. The superior class and experience of their players favor the visitors. However, Mozambique's excellent form and the support of their home crowd make their chances almost even.

  • Likely Outcome: A draw. In a battle between two equal and motivated opponents, a draw seems to be the most probable result.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the importance of the match and the solid defensive play of both teams, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' looks logical.
  • Key Factor: The battle for midfield. Whether Mozambique can impose its game and contain Guinea's star players.

Tune into the Mozambique vs Guinea live stream on tutsport.net and follow the tense battle in the World Cup qualifiers!

Join us for the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, as the Finland national team hosts Lithuania in Helsinki. This clash between two northern teams promises to be tense, with crucial points in the race for a spot at the planet's main tournament at stake.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 09, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Finland national team comes into this match as one of the contenders to qualify from the group. The 'Eagle-owls' have a balanced squad with players from strong European leagues. The team relies on an organized defense and quick counter-attacks featuring their key players. At their home arena, the Finns are particularly strong and will be aiming for a convincing victory to make a strong claim for World Cup qualification.

The Lithuania national team is one of the qualifying group's underdogs. The team is known for its fighting spirit and resilience but objectively lacks the class and consistency to compete with stronger opponents. For the Lithuanians, the trip to Helsinki is a major test, and their main goal will be to try to secure a sensational draw.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history of encounters between these teams is entirely in favor of Finland. The 'Eagle-owls' have won 3 of the last 4 head-to-head matches, with one game ending in a draw. The last time the teams met was in 2022, and on that occasion, Finland secured a comfortable 2-0 victory.

Finland vs Lithuania Prediction

Bookmakers and football experts consider the Finland national team the overwhelming favorites. Their home-field advantage, a higher class of players, and a successful head-to-head record all favor the Finnish team.

Join us for the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, as the Malta national team hosts one of the giants of world football, the Netherlands, at their National Stadium. This clash between a clear underdog and a group favorite has a predictable script.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 09, 2025, 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Malta national team is one of the weakest in Europe and traditionally finishes at the bottom of qualifying groups. For the 'Knights of St. John,' every match against a top national team is an opportunity to gain experience. At their home arena, the team will try to put up a fight against their more prestigious opponent by setting up a deep defense.

The Netherlands national team is one of the main favorites for direct qualification to the World Cup. The 'Oranje' have a world-class squad with players from Europe's top clubs. The team plays an attacking, dominant style of football and will be looking for a large and convincing victory to improve their goal difference.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history of encounters between these teams is entirely in favor of the Netherlands. The 'Oranje' have won all eight of their head-to-head matches, most of them by a large margin. The last time the teams met was in the Euro 2000 qualifiers, and on that occasion, the Netherlands secured two clean-sheet victories.

Malta vs Netherlands Prediction

Bookmakers and football experts see no intrigue in this match, predicting an easy and dominant victory for the Netherlands. The colossal difference in class, experience, and player quality leaves the hosts with absolutely no chance.

  • Likely Outcome: A comfortable victory for the Netherlands by a margin of three or more goals.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the attacking power of the Netherlands, a bet on 'Over 3.5 goals' looks highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The total superiority of the Netherlands in all aspects of the game. The only question is how many goals the 'Oranje' will score.

Czech Republic vs Croatia: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 09.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the central matches of the European qualifiers for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, as the Czech Republic hosts the bronze medalists of the last World Cup, Croatia, in Prague. This battle between two strong Slavic teams promises to be incredibly tense.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 09, 2025, 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Czech Republic national team comes into this match as a solid European side. The Czechs are known for their fighting spirit, athleticism, and dangerous set pieces. At their home arena, with the support of their fans, the Czech team is capable of challenging any opponent, no matter how prestigious. For the Czech Republic, the match against Croatia is key in the fight for direct qualification to the World Cup.

The Croatia national team is one of the favorites in their qualifying group. The 'Vatreni', led by their timeless captain Luka Modrić, have a world-class squad with players from Europe's top clubs. The Croatians rely on technical football and total control of the midfield. Despite playing away from home, Croatia will be playing for nothing less than a victory.

Head-to-Head (H2H) History

The history of official encounters between these teams favors Croatia. The teams met in the group stage of Euro 2020, and that match ended in a 1-1 draw. The national teams also played at Euro 2016, and on that occasion, a high-scoring 2-2 draw played into the hands of the Croatians. Croatia won their only friendly match.

Czech Republic vs Croatia Prediction

Bookmakers rate the chances of the teams as roughly even, with a slight edge to Croatia due to their higher class of players. The home-field advantage makes the Czech Republic a very dangerous opponent. A tactical battle is expected.

  • Likely Outcome: A draw. In a battle between two equal and resilient opponents, a draw seems to be the most probable result.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the importance of the match and the solid defensive play of both teams, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' looks logical.
  • Key Factor: The battle for midfield. Whether the Czech midfield, led by Tomáš Souček, can counter the genius of Luka Modrić.

Tune into the Czech Republic vs Croatia live stream on tutsport.net and follow the tense battle in the World Cup qualifiers!

Match Preview and Team Form

The United States U20 team comes into the tournament as one of the strongest in the world. The Americans are known for their athleticism, speed, and tactical discipline. The squad is composed of top young talents, many of whom are already playing in Europe. The match against Italy will be key for the USA in the fight for first place in the group.

The Italy U20 team is the current U-20 World Cup runners-up and one of the most tactically astute teams in the tournament.
